# Test fixtures: Maid of Honor Planner

These fixtures are TEST DATA for the Phase 2 engines, not a published pack.

- Tab names (12, in order) come from the live sheet verification recorded
  2026-10-25 in `workspace/etsy-maid-of-honor/listing-12-tab-reconciliation-draft-2026-10-25.md`.
- Prices (USD 13.97 list, USD 9.78 launch) are TASK SUPPLIED, not
  independently rechecked against a live Etsy listing. Reconfirm before
  published use.
- `isSampleRender: true` means the screen content drawn by the proof
  rasterizer is a SCHEMATIC built from the verified tab names, not a real
  sheet screenshot. No real sheet screenshot from Ali is used here, and no
  sheet screenshot from any competitor image is used anywhere. The real
  sheet render must replace the schematic before any published use, and the
  quality gate blocks a sample render from a real export.
- Copy in `maid-of-honor-copy.json` is test copy written for these tests
  from the verified tab names. It is not copied from any competitor image.
